items.title: Harvey Jones Interview
items.q: so they called you the second Louis Armstrong, yeah?

ctx.x: Oh, I stayed at Tick Young's, I guess. Enough to stay in jail all the time. Back and forth with the gangsters. Yeah, I stayed there about five, six months after Tick Young's.
And you do trumpet effects on the nose whistle, and so they called you the second Louis Armstrong, yeah?
That was when I was playing that other horn, but not on the other horn.
